description: This source file defines a configuration class for a proxy chat model, specifically 'LiteLLMProxyChatConfig', which extends the 'OpenAIGPTConfig' class. It provides methods for handling parameters, obtaining model info, and determining whether to use the LiteLLM proxy, tailored for integration with a chat-based large language model API.

classes.name: LiteLLMProxyChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that extends OpenAIGPTConfig to support proxying chat requests through LiteLLM, with additional methods for parameter mapping, model retrieval, and proxy control logic.
